full_judgment: 17. Regarding the question raised by learned Deputy Attorney General that the suit land being pond in type is non retainable land but the term pond does not strictly come within the preview of non retainable land as mandated in section 20(2)b and (2a) of the State Acquisition and tenancy Act. Any tank being excavated will not come within clutches of non retainable land. Conversely fishery being used for rearing and catching fish is non retainable and it is managed and controlled by the government.
